name: id
description: Set the unique identifier for the route.

name: title
description: Display title for tooling and docs.

name: description
description: Free-text description for the route.

name: enabled
description: Gate the route on a predicate; a false route is registered but not started, and not offered as a tool.

name: input
description: Validate the incoming exchange against a Standard Schema.

name: output
description: Validate the outgoing exchange against a Standard Schema.

name: tag
description: Attach one or more tags for filtering and discovery.

name: batch
description: Process exchanges in batches instead of one at a time.

name: error
description: Catch route-scope errors before from(), or wrap the next step after from().

name: authorize
description: Require an authenticated principal with optional roles or scopes.

name: from
description: Set the source that produces exchanges.

name: retry
description: Retry the next operation (or the whole pipeline) on failure.

name: throttle
description: Rate-limit the next operation (or the whole pipeline).

name: timeout
description: Fail the next operation (or the whole pipeline) after a deadline.

name: delay
description: Pause before the next operation.

name: cache
description: Cache and reuse the result of the next operation.

name: circuitBreaker
description: Trip after repeated failures and fast-fail until the target recovers.

name: concurrency
description: Bound how many exchanges run the next operation (or the whole pipeline) at once (bulkhead).

name: transform
description: Replace the body with the function's return value.

name: header
description: Set or override an exchange header.

name: authenticate
description: Mint a principal from claims the resolver has verified.

name: delegate
description: Mark the principal as exercised by an actor (an agent) on the subject’s behalf.

name: map
description: Map fields from source to target via a declarative mapping.

name: process
description: Transform with full read-write access to the exchange.

name: enrich
description: Pull data in; the result replaces the body unless an aggregator merges it.

name: filter
description: Drop exchanges that fail the predicate.

name: validate
description: Check the body with a validator; the coerced result replaces it.

name: schema
description: Strip unknown fields per a schema, fail on validation errors.

name: dedupe
description: Drop exchanges whose derived key has already been seen.

name: choice
description: Branch the pipeline by predicate.

name: split
description: Fan out one exchange into many.

name: aggregate
description: Fold the children of a split back into one exchange.

name: multicast
description: Fan the exchange out to multiple paths in parallel.

name: dispatch
description: Run exactly one target, chosen by load-balancing strategy.

name: loop
description: Repeat a sub-pipeline while a condition holds.

name: sample
description: Pass every Nth exchange, or the first per time window.

name: debounce
description: Release only the last exchange in a burst after a quiet period.

name: suspend
description: Park the exchange durably and answer now; resume later at the next step.

name: resume
description: Revive a parked exchange addressed by its signed resume token.

name: tap
description: Run a destination or enricher fire-and-forget; the body is unchanged.

name: log
description: Emit a log line for the exchange.

name: debug
description: Emit a log line for the exchange at debug level.

name: to
description: Push out via a destination (body unchanged) or pull in via an enricher (body replaced).
